<translate>
The '''Fusion Dance''' (Metamoru) is the classic dance fusion. It uses the '''Fusion''' skill and costs nothing but timing, but it has the strictest requirements of the three [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusions|fusion methods]]: both dancers must be the same race, in the same form, and close in power.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Fusion skill ==

Both players need the '''Fusion''' skill, taught by [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (Good alignment). It has 5 levels, and its level sets how long the fusion lasts.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Level</translate> !! 1 !! 2 !! 3 !! 4 !! 5
|-
! <translate>TP cost</translate>
| 25,000 || 5,000 || 10,000 || 15,000 || 20,000
|}

<translate>
== Requirements ==

* Both players must have the '''Fusion''' skill.
* Both players must be the '''same race'''.
* Both players must be in the '''same form''': both in base form, or both in the same transformation and the same stack form (for example, both Super Saiyan 2 with [[Special:MyLanguage/Kaioken|Kaioken]]). The fusion is born in that form.
* Neither player may be an upgraded [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]]: Androids can't dance.
* The two players' total stats must be close enough. If the gap is larger than 50% (the server default), the dance fails with a "level gap" message.
* Neither player may already be fused, be '''in combat''', or be on '''Fusion cooldown'''.
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|metamoruFusionThreshold}}

<translate>
== Performing the dance ==

# Both players open the Utility Menu ({{Key|X}}) and select the '''Fusion''' action.
# Both players '''hold the Action key''' ({{Key|G}}) to charge the dance. While charging you are locked in place and your facing is frozen.
# Two players charging the dance within '''8 blocks''' of each other pair up: both turn to face the same way, side by side, and glide into place so their fingertips meet at the end of the dance. If one of the spots is blocked or has no ground, they only turn. Both charges restart together, so the full dance always plays before the fusion. If the two can't fuse (different race or form, an Android, too big a stat gap), both get the reason right away and nobody moves.
# When one player reaches a '''full charge''' while the partner, within about 5 blocks, is at least '''half-charged and still charging''', the fusion triggers. '''The player whose charge fills first becomes the leader''' and controls the fused body; the partner rides along as a passenger.
</translate>

<translate>
== Result ==

* Bonus stats are added from the partner's STR, SKP and PWR, scaled from '''×1.25 to ×2.0''' depending on how evenly matched the two were: the closer their stats, the bigger the multiplier.
* The duration scales with the '''average Fusion skill level''' of the two players. With both at the maximum level, the fusion lasts the full server duration.
* When it ends, '''both''' players go on '''Fusion cooldown''' (30 minutes by default).

What you can and can't do while fused is described on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusions|Fusions]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Failure messages ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Message</translate> !! <translate>Reason</translate>
|-
| <translate>"You can only fuse (Metamoru) with players of the same race."</translate> || <translate>Different races.</translate>
|-
| <translate>"You can only fuse (Metamoru) while both of you are in the same form."</translate> || <translate>Different forms or stack forms.</translate>
|-
| <translate>"You can only fuse (Metamoru) with a player similar in level to you."</translate> || <translate>The stat gap is too large.</translate>
|-
| <translate>"Androids cannot perform fusion."</translate> || <translate>One of the players is an upgraded Android.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Notes ==

* The Fusion cooldown only blocks the Fusion Dance. You can still fuse with [[Special:MyLanguage/Potara Earrings|Potara Earrings]] or [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bug Beetles|Medi-Bug Beetles]] while it runs.
* To fuse with a player of another race, use the Potara Earrings or the Medi-Bug Beetles instead.
</translate>
